visual_decomposition.layout: Two-by-two overview/detail arrangement, black vertical/horizontal dividers and large A–D labels; A left overview, B top-right AE expansion, C bottom-left UNet expansion, D bottom-right reusable module definitions.
visual_decomposition.hierarchy: Large gray rounded containers group AE/diffusion networks; named color blocks define repeated submodules. Black circular ports mark module boundaries.
visual_decomposition.color_and_symbols: Blue architecture modules/ResBlocks, purple U-Blocks, green ConvBlocks, orange Down and yellow Up; explicit names carry meaning. Multiplication and addition circles in B express different operators. D shows residual additions and inner bypasses.
visual_decomposition.legend: No separate color legend; module names and repeated color identities provide the key. Caption supplies dashed-line AE-only scope, time/label input meaning and default kernel/normalization/activation. The AE-only dashed-shortcut qualifier is localized to A/B. D also contains dashed projections; their full conditional activation is not mapped in this macro card. Do not assign one meaning to every dashed mark.
visual_decomposition.reading_path: A starts left→right for encoding/noising and returns right→left through UNet/decoder; B similarly folds encoder and decoder rows. Detail panels explain nesting rather than chronological new stages.
visual_decomposition.reuse_boundary: Transfer overview/detail hierarchy and explicit operator meaning. Do not copy exact palette, layer counts, architecture settings, source pixels or the overview's omitted sampling transition into a new literal execution graph.

redraw_mapping.proposed: AE-training stage: observed x→encoder distribution→sampled z→decoder→reconstruction; observed x also supplies reconstruction reference
redraw_mapping.boundary: KL acts on the encoded distribution; multi-resolution L1/LPIPS/SSIM/PatchGAN belong to AE training. If discriminator training is not expanded, do not imply it is absent.

redraw_mapping.original: A Gaussian Diffusion, binary condition and UNet; C conditioning
redraw_mapping.proposed: Diffusion-training stage: frozen encoder yields z0; sampled perturbation and time yield zt; conditioned UNet estimates noise; L1 compares estimate with the sampled noise
redraw_mapping.boundary: Dataset class is conditioning, not the numerical noise target. CheXpert uncertain classes were relabeled; class does not universally mean measured clinical truth.

redraw_mapping.proposed: Conditional generation: fresh latent Gaussian initialization→current latent; UNet prediction plus current latent/schedule→DDIM update; final generated latent→fixed decoder→synthetic image
redraw_mapping.boundary: Noise estimate and latent state are different objects. Ordinary sample() takes no observed patient image or encoder input; generated output is neither a new clinical observation nor reconstruction of an identified input.

redraw_mapping.proposed: Keep macro module names and conditioning; omit layer-level expansions unless the task needs them
redraw_mapping.boundary: No complete layer/checkpoint matching or inferred parameter-sharing among imaging domains.

nontransferable_or_unresolved: P:77 says 4 instead of 8 channels, whereas Figure 2 caption P:82 attributes improved reconstruction to 8. CT:85–86 uses 8 in its example. This is retained as a real source conflict; no exact shared latent channel count is selected, and Figure 2 was not visually inspected.

P:122 supports 1000 training noise-schedule steps and 150 DDIM generation steps; these are study-specific, not defaults for other diagrams. Its 256→32 and 512→64 examples indicate per-axis spatial reduction, not an eightfold reduction of all tensor elements.

Pinned code supports class dropout, guidance and optional unconditional execution (C:121–126,232–251; README:51); the paper's figure is actually conditional. Full experimental CFG/eta configuration is unresolved; C:301–304 allows per-step stochasticity, so deterministic DDIM is not assumed.
The pre-publication code's exact correspondence to formal experiment checkpoints, every imaging-domain model and layer/tensor setting is unverified.
F:A omits sampling state updates. Preserve its role as an overview; do not take the drawn UNet→decoder connection as a literal noise-estimate→decoder algorithm.

No performance values or patient images are reconstructed here. Reported image metrics and downstream classification do not establish clinical validity or privacy; P:90,104–106 reports relevant limitations.
No same-patient multimodal fusion, clinical deployment, anonymization guarantee, generated disease ground truth, model execution or weights/data license is inferred.
